{{Quote|I'm certain you have terribly important business, but might you find time to do one small service for a diplomat of the Republic?|Devar Gann|<ref name="Star Wars: The Old Republic">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref>}}
'''Devar Gann''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] diplomat of the living [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. His sister [[Kindra Gann]] suffered from a rare form of [[Mizra Syndrome]] since birth, but was healed following a pilgrimage to the [[Shrine of Healing]] on [[Voss]]. As a payment for the treatment, she chose to stay at the Shrine, serving the [[Voss Mystics|Voss Mystic]] [[Kina-Re]]. The [[Devar and Kindra Gann's mother|mother]] of the Gann siblings was also ill and Devar promised to notify Kindra should anything happen to her. That occasion came to pass around [[3640 BBY]], but when their mother was on her deathbed, Devar found he had no way to contact his sister. Using diplomatic channels, he contacted a Republic privateer named [[Voidhound]] who was on Voss on his own business and promised payment in reward for delivering the information to Kindra at the Shrine.
